summary.text: Sky chief clouds form from the breath of sky chief beasts and can build an environment that raises cloud path Gu production in an immortal aperture.

claims.text: Sky chief clouds form from the breath of the sky chief beast, condensing slowly over long periods. Spread out, a lot can stretch over a thousand and three hundred square kilometres, a scale Qin Bai Sheng calls rare even in treasure yellow heaven. In an immortal aperture they can build an environment that greatly increases cloud path Gu worm production; with sky chief beasts living in that cloudy setting, and with proper management, the clouds can keep flowing without end. Intact parts of the immemorial nine heavens, where sky chief beast groups live, are hard for anyone below powerful rank seven or rank eight to explore.

At Qin Bai Sheng’s auction, a lot of sky chief clouds opens at twenty immortal essence stones. Tai Bai Yun Sheng bids for them for Tai Bai blessed land and wins at sixty immortal essence stones. He plans to use them with float ball tea and later jade hummingbirds as building blocks toward sky flowers and floating sparrowhawks.
In Tai Bai blessed land after the purchase, large numbers of sky chief clouds hold flowers in the sky while sparrowhawks fly around them.
Fang Yuan notes that float ball tea, sky chief clouds, and like resources cannot be restored with Landscape as Before Immortal Gu if lost in a tribulation fight.
